security_audit.summary: Most static findings are documentation false positives from Markdown links, code fences, and expected Claude plugin manifest paths. Confirmed risks remain for command examples that run repository scripts or CLI commands, and for instructions that inspect local Claude Code logs. No prompt injection or data exfiltration intent was found.

remediation.suggestion: Require explicit user confirmation before running validation or sync scripts. Document what each script checks before use.
Ask for user consent before reading Claude Code logs. Prefer a redacted excerpt instead of continuous tail output.
Label command blocks as manual examples. State that agents must confirm before running local commands.

content.value_statement: Plugin contributors need consistent repository rules before editing ANcpLua Claude plugins. This skill gives agents a focused guide for structure, validation, debugging, and release checks.
actual_capabilities: Explains the ANcpLua plugin directory layout and manifest placement rules.
Guides creation of plugin folders, manifests, README files, and optional skills.
Lists validation checks for manifests, marketplace sync, JSON syntax, permissions, and paths.
Documents naming, Git, branch, commit, and documentation conventions.
Provides troubleshooting steps for Claude Code plugin loading and behavior issues.
limitations: It is specific to the ANcpLua ancplua-claude-plugins repository.
It references repository scripts, but it does not include those scripts.
Shell commands and log access require explicit user permission.
It cannot verify runtime behavior without access to the target plugin files.

use_cases.title: Scaffold a new plugin
use_cases.description: Create a plugin plan that follows the expected folders, manifest fields, README requirements, and validation checklist.

use_cases.title: Update an existing plugin
use_cases.description: Review planned changes against naming, manifest, path, Git, and documentation conventions before editing.

use_cases.title: Prepare a release review
use_cases.description: Check marketplace sync, version consistency, changelog updates, documentation, and validation status before opening a pull request.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a new plugin
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to plan a new ANcpLua plugin named <plugin-name>. List required folders, manifest fields, README tasks, and validation steps.

prompt_templates.title: Review plugin changes
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to review my planned changes to <plugin-name>. Check path variables, manifest placement, naming, documentation, and release checklist items.

prompt_templates.title: Debug validation failure
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to diagnose why <plugin-name> fails validation. Ask before running commands, then inspect JSON syntax, permissions, paths, and marketplace sync.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare a pull request
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to prepare a pull request for <plugin-name>. Verify conventions, expected docs, version consistency, changelog status, and remaining risks.

Notes on path portability and manifest placement.

output_examples.input: Debug why a plugin does not load.
output: A stepwise diagnosis path for manifest syntax, permissions, hardcoded paths, and component isolation.
A request for permission before running local commands or reading logs.
A concise summary of likely causes and next checks.

best_practices: Read the conventions guide before changing plugin structure or manifest locations.
Ask before running repository scripts, CLI commands, or viewing Claude Code logs.
Use portable path variables and keep plugin assets outside the manifest-only directory.
anti_patterns: Putting skills, commands, or hooks inside the manifest-only directory.
Hardcoding user-specific absolute paths in plugin configuration.
Running validation scripts or reading logs without explicit user consent.

faq.question: What is this skill for?
faq.answer: It guides agents working on plugins in the ANcpLua Claude plugin monorepo.

faq.question: Which tools can use it?
faq.answer: It is marked for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code workflows.

faq.question: Does it create plugins automatically?
faq.answer: No. It provides repository rules, checklists, and prompts that guide plugin creation.

faq.question: Does it need shell access?
faq.answer: Some validation steps use shell commands. Agents should ask before running them.

faq.question: Can it be used outside the ANcpLua repository?
faq.answer: It can inform similar Claude plugin work, but its rules are repository-specific.

faq.question: What should be reviewed before publishing?
faq.answer: Review manifest fields, version sync, README content, changelog updates, validation results, and permission-sensitive debugging steps.
